title: Discount is incorrectly applied to orders below Rs 1,000
body:
The e-commerce application provides a 10% discount for orders of Rs 1,000 or more. However, customers have reported that the discount is also being applied to orders below Rs 1,000.
Steps to reproduce: 1. Add products worth Rs 800 to the cart. 2. Proceed to checkout. 3. Observe the bill.
Expected: orders below Rs 1,000 should not receive a discount; the discount should be 0 and the amount before tax should remain Rs 800.
Actual: the application applies a 10% discount (Rs 80) and the discounted amount is Rs 720.
The issue occurs consistently. The repository contains existing unit tests for checkout functionality.
